name: onmhj
description: Local AI-session capture with chunked raw-first reports and ordered retries.

interface.longDescription: Captures Codex hook events and public references cited in final answers to local JSONL, then generates validated task-centered final reports from that raw evidence through local Codex auth or an OpenAI-compatible API. Large inputs are split on complete JSONL records, summarized with bounded concurrency, and resumed from validated part caches. Missing reports are retried in work-date order, and a date is confirmed only after raw, report, and device confirmation are committed successfully.
